SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, c.contract_id AS contractId, c.contract_start_date AS startDate, c.contract_end_date AS endDate, u.user_id AS freelancerId, u.name AS freelancerName, c.client_rating AS rating, c.client_experience AS reviewContent, c.client_is_renewal_intended AS renewalIntended
FROM projects p INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON p.project_id = pa.project_id INNER JOIN contracts c ON pa.application_id = c.contract_id INNER JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id
WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.project_status = 'CLOSED' LIMIT 1
